specs.safety: 6 airbags, ESP, all-wheel disc brakes (top trims)

reviews.author: Gurpreet Sandhu
reviews.title: Road presence and torque nobody else in segment matches
reviews.text: Body-on-frame toughness with genuinely modern cabin tech — the combination is hard to find elsewhere. 4WD variant handles Punjab's rural roads without a second thought.

reviews.author: Ovais Ahmed
reviews.title: Fantastic on hill terrain, fuel costs add up
reviews.text: Given the weight and low-range 4WD, mileage is naturally on the lower side, but the capability on snow and gravel is unmatched in this price bracket.

spareParts.authorizedServiceNote: Mahindra's rural and semi-urban dealer reach is among the best in the industry, particularly useful for owners outside metro cities.
spareParts.tip: For 4WD variants, service the transfer case fluid at Mahindra-recommended intervals — this is the single biggest factor in long-term 4WD reliability.

faqs.q: Which variant is best for occasional off-roading?
faqs.a: The Z6 and Z8L with the 4WD option add a low-range transfer case and hill descent control, worth the premium if you regularly leave paved roads.

reviews.author: Tanvi Joshi
reviews.title: ADAS + twin-screen setup feels genuinely premium
reviews.text: The blend of safety tech, road manners and interior space is hard to beat at this price. Adaptive cruise control alone makes long highway drives far less tiring.

reviews.author: Rajat Kapoor
reviews.title: Waiting periods can still be long on top trims
reviews.text: Car itself is excellent, but AX7L trims occasionally see multi-month waiting periods depending on the region — worth checking with your dealer before finalising a delivery date.

spareParts.authorizedServiceNote: As Mahindra's flagship, larger dealerships in metro cities keep the fullest stock of ADAS-related sensors and twin-screen display units.
spareParts.tip: Any ADAS sensor replacement requires a recalibration at an authorised centre — do not accept uncalibrated aftermarket sensor swaps.

faqs.q: Is AWD available on the XUV700?
faqs.a: Yes, AWD is offered on select top diesel automatic trims and pairs with Mahindra's terrain response modes for light off-road use.
